overloads.semanticRole: Modifies the value of the element designated by elementRef (or by an XPath expression relative to it, if xPath is passed), optionally writing the value as CDATA when the trailing '*' is passed.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

constraints: If elementValue is undefined, an empty string is used.
If elementRef designates a BLOB, the value is automatically base64-encoded (and DOM GET XML ELEMENT VALUE automatically decodes it back).
All CR and CRLF end-of-line characters in elementValue are replaced by LF to comply with XML processing rules.
Arrays, pictures, and pointers cannot be passed as elementValue.
